title: Bootstrap Quick Reference
description: Find a Bootstrap class and read its job in plain words. These class names need Bootstrap 5 CSS. Parts that open or close also need its JavaScript.

entries.name: .container
entries.summary: Holds page content and limits its width on larger screens.

entries.name: .container-fluid
entries.summary: Makes a container that uses the full available width.

entries.name: .row
entries.summary: Groups grid columns into one row inside a container.

entries.name: .col
entries.summary: Shares the row space with other columns of the same kind.

entries.name: .col-12
entries.summary: Uses all 12 parts of a grid row, so the box takes a full row.

entries.name: .col-md-6
entries.summary: Uses half the row from the md screen size upwards.
notes: In Bootstrap 5, md starts at a viewport width of 768px.

entries.name: .g-3
entries.summary: Adds a gap between grid columns and rows.

entries.name: .p-3
entries.summary: Adds space inside all four edges of a box.
notes: The 3 is a spacing step, not a pixel count.

entries.name: .mb-3
entries.summary: Adds space after a box, below its bottom edge.

entries.name: .mx-auto
entries.summary: Can centre a box with a set width by sharing the left and right margin.

entries.name: .d-flex
entries.summary: Places child boxes in a flexible row by default.

entries.name: .gap-2
entries.summary: Adds a small gap between items in a flex or grid layout.

entries.name: .text-center
entries.summary: Lines up text in the centre of its box.

entries.name: .fw-bold
entries.summary: Gives the text a bold font weight.

entries.name: .lead
entries.summary: Makes an opening paragraph stand out with a larger text style.

entries.name: .btn
entries.summary: Adds the shared shape and spacing for a button.

entries.name: .btn-primary
entries.summary: Uses the main theme colour for a button.

entries.name: .btn-outline-primary
entries.summary: Gives a button a coloured outline and a clear background at rest.

entries.name: .card
entries.summary: Groups related words or pictures in a styled box.

entries.name: .card-body
entries.summary: Adds the inner space for the main content of a card.

entries.name: .card-title
entries.summary: Styles the title inside a card.

entries.name: .badge
entries.summary: Makes a small label, such as a count beside a heading.

entries.name: .form-label
entries.summary: Adds space below the visible label for a form field.
notes: Use the same value for the label for and the input id.

entries.name: .form-control
entries.summary: Styles a text input or a textarea.

entries.name: .form-select
entries.summary: Styles a select box that lets the reader choose an option.

entries.name: .alert
entries.summary: Adds the shared spacing and border for a message box.

entries.name: .alert-success
entries.summary: Uses the success colour style for a message.
notes: Include a clear message. Do not use colour as the only way to explain a result.

entries.name: .navbar
entries.summary: Styles a bar of site links, often near the top of a page.

entries.name: data-bs-target
entries.summary: Points to the id of the part that a Bootstrap control should open.
notes: This needs the correct Bootstrap JavaScript control and a matching id.

entries.name: data-bs-toggle="modal"
entries.summary: Tells Bootstrap JavaScript that this control opens a modal pop-up.

entries.name: data-bs-theme="dark"
entries.summary: Asks Bootstrap 5.3 to use its dark colours in this part of the page.

entries.name: $primary
entries.summary: Sets the main theme colour when you build Bootstrap CSS with Sass.
notes: Set this before the main Bootstrap import. Sass is a build tool, not code the browser runs.
